title: Nirmal Purja, Renowned Mountaineer, Is Found Dead After Pakistan Avalanche
summary: The British-Nepali mountaineer was one of 10 climbers who were struck by an avalanche on Thursday on Broad Peak, one of the world’s highest mountains.
